title: Solar Flare
text: Each unshielded satellite in lunar orbit, L2 or GEO rolls a d10. On 1–3 it loses this round of operations.

title: Space Debris Warning
text: Each LEO satellite without propulsion skips operations this round. Its three-round lifetime still advances.

title: Launch Delay
text: No agency may launch. Building, data collection and downlinks continue.

title: Budget Cut
text: Each agency loses 3 BC. Stop at zero, then collect normal funding.

title: Rideshare Opportunity
text: Halve every launch price. Round up after any agreed split.

title: Research Grant
text: The agency with the fewest SP gains 5 BC. Tied agencies each receive the grant.

title: Tech Breakthrough
text: The Mission Lead selects one named part in the Market. Every copy costs 1 BC less, to a minimum of zero.

title: Ground Station Pass
text: Every working satellite may downlink this round, even if its regular link is unavailable.

title: Crosswinds
text: Launches to LEO or SSO cost 1 extra BC.

title: Array Calibration
text: Working satellites with deployable panels collect 1 extra Data this round.

title: Eclipse Passage
text: Satellites without a battery collect 1 less Data this round, to a minimum of zero.

title: Signal Fade
text: Only high-gain antennas may downlink this round. Other satellites retain their data.

title: Thermal Stress
text: Each satellite without shielding adds 1 Risk for this round’s check.

title: Spare Electronics
text: Each agency may buy a redundant computer for 1 BC less, to a minimum of zero.

title: Pointing Drift
text: Satellites without wheels or magnetorquers collect no new Data this round.

title: Antenna Maintenance
text: S-band radios miss this downlink. Keep all stored Data.

title: Peer Review
text: Each agency may run one Trade Study without paying its 1 BC fee. It still uses an action.

title: Panel Degradation
text: A satellite with body-mounted cells and no deployable panels collects 1 less Data, minimum zero.

title: Clear Launch Window
text: Every launch costs 1 BC less, to a minimum of zero.

title: Extra Ground Pass
text: Each working satellite with stored Data may downlink it, even between scheduled passes.
